purpose: A pilot: paired Lite C historical pitch input ablation, four baseline inputs versus the same four plus Pab1/Pab2/Pab3, three seeds and six fresh validation-only trainings.
controls: Retrain both arms under the same updated code/environment. Keep M1 targets and M1 early stopping, MAE, state BCE coefficient 0.05, 144-step history, stride and optimizer fixed. No changes to pooling, local state features, masks or preprocessing. Append pitch only to the pooled encoder.

analysis.primary: Dense M1 MAE among latest-finite historical power anchors <10 kW, scored against the matched fresh C_inputs4 seed.
analysis.bounds: Pitch associations can reflect target-mask selection and imputation; S1 is a posthoc diagnosis and cannot select a deployed model. Six runs are a pilot, not a formal interaction or significance study.

decision: Return all six runs. Do not choose on native early-stop scores, auto-evaluate test, or append seeds. Assess paired dense-validation primary and mandatory subgroup effects locally; no new numeric acceptance threshold is introduced by this code change.
